subject: Biology
title: The Waggle Dance of Bees
description: A 60-second lesson on The Waggle Dance of Bees.

hook.text: A honeybee returns to the hive and starts dancing on the comb. Other bees watch intently.

buildup.text: The waggle dance communicates the direction, distance, and quality of a food source.

discovery.text: The angle of the dance relative to the sun indicates direction. The duration indicates distance.

twist.text: Karl von Frisch decoded this language in the 1940s and won a Nobel Prize for it.

climax.text: Bees make democratic decisions—scouts dance for competing sites, and the hive votes by following.

punchline.text: Bees speak in choreography. And they vote by dancing.

quiz.question: What does the angle of a bee's waggle dance indicate?

details.summary: Honeybees communicate the direction and distance of food sources through a waggle dance performed inside the dark hive. The angle of the dance relative to vertical indicates direction relative to the sun, and the duration encodes distance.
details.whyItMatters: Karl von Frisch's decoding of the waggle dance earned a Nobel Prize and revealed that insects possess symbolic communication. It remains one of the most sophisticated non-human communication systems known.
takeaways: Dance angle relative to vertical encodes direction relative to the sun
Waggle duration indicates distance to the food source
Dance vigor communicates the quality of the food source

faq.question: How accurate is bee navigation from the waggle dance?
faq.answer: Bees can locate food sources several kilometers away with remarkable precision from dance information alone. The system accounts for the sun's movement across the sky, adjusting directions relative to time of day.

faq.question: Do other insects communicate like honeybees?
faq.answer: Some stingless bee species use similar communication, and some ants lay trail pheromones that encode distance. But the honeybee waggle dance remains unique in its sophistication as a symbolic abstract representation of spatial information.
